comment: Dr. Motz is a great teacher, but it's a hard class. He's very flexible and will work with students outside of class.

Dr. Motz is a great professor, you can tell he thoroughly enjoys the subject. The work is manageable and he gives run downs on the structure and content of tests, so you have a lot of tools to succeed. Highly recommend.

Dr. Motz is the perfect combination of nerdy but passionate. He clearly loves his field of archaeology, meaning his lectures are filled with interesting information and personal stories. Tests are extremely easy assuming you can operate quizlet or flashcards, so all you gain is insight into the ancient world through a passionate teacher. He's great

dr. motz is an amazing teacher, you can tell he's super passionate about what he teaches so his lectures were always very enjoyable. exams are honestly not too difficult if you're good at memorizing things quickly but make sure to be very through in all of your responses, he sometimes will knock off a couple points if you're too vague.

Dr. Motz is a great professor. He is extremely knowledgable and his enthusiasm for the topics we covered made it really fun and interesting to learn from him. Easy to get 100% on all homework assignments, and tests are an easy A+ as long as you actually take notes in class and study your notes thoroughly.
Professor Motz is a great professor. The work was all manageable and he made himself accessible to work on it outside of class. His lectures were great and he is overall a super friendly guy.

I had no idea what archaeology was going to be like, but Dr. Motz made the best first impression, and I loved going to his class. Homeworks only consisted of textbook readings, and lectures gave you all the info you need to ace his tests. His witty humor and care for his students made the class even better, and I will be taking him again. Take him!
